model_policy.campaign_condition: Complex and solvent legs must use identical orthorhombic periodic box vectors and the identical ghost-tree policy.
model_policy.inactive_unique_bonds: Native positive harmonic bond tree retained unchanged
limitations: Instantaneous physical-anchor forces include ghost bonds; only the integrated physical marginal is unchanged.
Additional inactive angles/torsions, nonbonded interactions, multiple anchors, cycles or differing leg boxes invalidate this cancellation argument.
No complete solvated model or production sampling protocol is accepted by this construction.
model_policy.masses: Positive native element masses retained at every lambda; identical endpoint masses.
model_policy.partition_argument: For each singly anchored tree, transform every ghost coordinate to its parent-relative displacement on the periodic torus. The transformation has unit Jacobian; the harmonic bond potential is a sum over independent edge displacements. Integration therefore factors into edge partition integrals independent of physical anchor coordinates. Identical box vectors and edge potentials make these factors cancel between complex and solvent transformations.

stream_encoding: Each scalar is the exact binary128 embedding of its binary64 source value, stored in the low 128 bits of bytes32; indices are uint256. No new numerical precision is invented.
